brief:
Israeli forces arrested six Palestinians across the occupied West Bank, including 17-year-old Mahmoud Daher Mahmoud Daoud from Beita, south of Nablus, Middle East Eye reported. The arrests occurred amid ongoing tensions in the territory.

In a separate incident, Israeli settlers stole sheep belonging to Palestinians in the West Bank. The theft is part of a pattern of settler actions targeting Palestinian communities and their property.
